description: This file defines the React component 'Transactions' which manages and displays financial transaction data. It includes state management for transaction items, filtering by category, modal for adding new transactions, and hooks for data fetching and form handling.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches transactions for the current month and category, updates the items state.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for adding a new transaction, performs validation, updates state, and reloads data.
